headline: GP Petroleums Limited: Agreements
sum: Agreements - GP Petroleums Limited has informed the Exchange about the execution of Share Purchase Agreement with Incubit Pipavav Terminal Private Limited (IPTPL) and its selling shareholder for the acquisition of a 22.45% stake in IPTPL.
